notes.title: Release will happen today!
notes.notes:
First of all, I'd like to thank each and everyone who's following this game. Thank you for your support!

HERE ARE SOME IMPORTANT NEWS:

 The release date has been changed. The game will be available today!
 Please note that this is a re-release! Check that you don't have the game in your Library before purchase. 주의! 이것은 게임의 재 발표입니다. 구매하기 전에 게임이 라이브러리에 없는지 확인하십시오. Пожалуйста, обратите внимание, что это перевыпуск игры. Перед покупкой убедитесь, что игра не содержится в Вашей библиотеке.
 Achievements added and tested successfully.


Thank you for your attention, and I hope you will enjoy Midsummer Night as much as we did during the development.

- Alex
